meta.name: tzst
meta.description: Use when the user needs to create, extract, flatten, list, test, install, script, or troubleshoot `tzst` CLI workflows for `.tzst` or `.tar.zst` archives, including compression levels, streaming mode, extraction filters, conflict resolution, JSON output, or standalone binary setup, even if they describe the archive task without naming `tzst`.

copy.tagline: 压缩或解压 tzst 格式的归档文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理 .tar.zst 格式的压缩文件
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with .tar.zst archives

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 tzst 命令行工具处理 .tzst 或 .tar.zst 压缩包，包括创建、解压、列出内容、测试完整性等操作。
howto.when: 当你提到 .tzst 或 .tar.zst 文件，或需要创建、解压、列出、测试这类压缩包时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 tzst 压缩这个文件夹
say.note: Claude 会执行 tzst create 命令。

say.text: 解压这个 .tzst 文件到当前目录
say.note: Claude 会执行 tzst extract 命令。

say.text: 列出这个 .tar.zst 压缩包里的文件
say.note: Claude 会执行 tzst list 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use the tzst CLI to create, extract, list, or test .tzst and .tar.zst archives.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention .tzst or .tar.zst files, or need to create, extract, list, or test such archives.

say_en.text: Extract this .tzst file to the current directory.
